title: UpsertCompany
description: A legal entity from any source (GLEIF, EDGAR, EU listings, etc.). The gmr_id is canonical and stable across sources; producers compute it from a hard ID (LEI, CIK, VAT) or a name+country last-resort. Source-specific fields ride along but most properties are optional.

entity_kind.description: GLEIF entity.category, verbatim (GENERAL | FUND | BRANCH | SOLE_PROPRIETOR | ...). The ONLY authority for the :Company vs :InvestmentFund label — never inferred from instruments.

registered_as.description: GLEIF RegistrationAuthorityEntityID — the entity's ID in its national business register (CVR/RCS/Handelsregister/Cegjegyzek/...). An exact join key into national datasets.

registered_at.description: GLEIF RegistrationAuthorityID (RA code, e.g. RA000170) — which register registered_as belongs to.

registration_status.description: GLEIF Registration.RegistrationStatus (ISSUED | LAPSED | RETIRED | ...) — the LEI's lifecycle, distinct from entity active/inactive.

entity_creation_date.description: GLEIF EntityCreationDate — when the legal entity was formed.

hq_address.description: Headquarters address first line (may differ from legal).

aliases.description: GLEIF OtherEntityNames (trade/transliterated/previous names) — verbatim, for entity matching.
